ownership: Independent read-only observer/callsite/numeric review. Publisher/process/protocol review is owned separately by baseline_audit. This reviewer did not change author/root branches, execute fixtures, trigger corpus work, or read fresh data.

findings.reason: Entry/exit event arguments must be exact BuiltinMethodType on exact frozen Connection/Cursor receiver classes. Strict current-stack pairing checks frame identity, receiver identity, native owner, static method descriptor and method name. Wrapper object identity is recorded independently; the preserved actual CPython witness disproves arg-is as a universal pairing requirement.

An existing profiler is not replaced. Callback exceptions, replaced callbacks, invalid lifecycle, negative spans, wrong receiver/frame/method and an unclosed target stack invalidate the observation. Native exception exits remain distinguishable from observer failure. observe_payload now retains current spans if latency removal or payload fingerprinting fails after recall.

frozen_filename_map verifies the complete source before installing the callback. Callback access is limited to builtin event/frame/code metadata and ephemeral native receiver identity. Code objects are retained so cached id(code) keys cannot be recycled. Frozen upper caller metadata distinguishes the two _candidate_rows fetchall uses.

Unclassified primary sites and disabled cache/coverage/optional-source categories remain in raw spans but make all_classification_sites_valid false, preventing final completion. Other ordinary SQLite builtins remain in an explicit other bucket. The residual is explicitly unattributed, not described as Python-only.

Terminal timestamp is taken at callback entry. Inclusive spans subtract only direct child inclusive spans for exclusive totals; callback bookkeeping is separately reported. Scope explicitly retains Python callbacks, scheduling and observer effects inside builtin spans. Neither callback bookkeeping nor fixed artificial calibration is used as an overhead correction.

verified_callsite_mapping.note: Multiline source expressions are covered by the declared rule ranges. Novelty/original pages/turns retain execute-only labels because implicit cursor iteration is not fully observed.

open_findings.statement: The real producer enforces LIFO. Its saved numeric auditor checks individual arithmetic, parent containment, direct-child sums and aggregate wall totals but does not reconstruct temporal sibling/root order. Two overlapping root intervals can therefore pass the auditor while double-counting their union time.
open_findings.evidence_limit: Predicate-by-predicate static review; this reviewer did not execute the witness or claim it occurred in actual data.
open_findings.minimal_proposal: While traversing stored sequence order, track active ancestors; on closing before a new sibling/root, require the closed span end<=new span start, and require declared parent to equal the active parent. Preserve zero-duration boundaries and all existing arithmetic checks. Add overlapping-root, overlapping-sibling and incompatible-parent negative artificial cases.
open_findings.disposition: Root decides whether to require this bounded numeric-audit strengthening. No author source change was made here.
